name: Earth
kidSummary: These are Earth's size and pull, from NASA's fact sheet. A round Earth in the game is a simplification. The real Earth is a little wider at the equator.
unavailableReason: This file is Earth constants, not a launch.

equatorialRadiusKm.note: NASA fact sheet equatorial radius. A spherical model that uses only this radius is a simplification. Multiply by 1000 for metres.

polarRadiusKm.note: NASA fact sheet polar radius. Kept so the equatorial figure is not mistaken for a mean radius.

gmKm3PerS2.note: NASA prints GM as 0.39860 times 10^6 km^3/s^2. That product is 398600 km^3/s^2. Multiply by 10^9 for m^3/s^2. Not a new measurement.

standardGravityMps2.note: The fact sheet says this standard acceleration is defined (CODATA 2018) as exact. It is not the mean surface gravity field.

meanSurfaceGravityMps2.note: NASA fact sheet mean surface gravity, printed as 9.820. Not the standard gravity, and not a constant used in place of GM.
